The multiplayer online battle arena game launched on Switch in July 2021 and landed on mobile a few months later. It supported cross-platform play between them. stories.title: Kyle Whittingham explains disastrous Michigan play call vs. Indiana
stories.summary: Michigan football faces scrutiny after questionable red zone playcalling led to a loss against Indiana. Perhaps the most egregious display came against Indiana , when the Wolverines had a third-and-goal from the one-yard line. Instead of running the football to try and get a touchdown on the opening drive in the second half, the call was for quarterback Tommy Carr to run a play-action, where he turned his back to the defense. By the time he was done rolling out, an Indiana defensive end was there to make the sack. The maize and blue were pushed back to the 15-yard line, where they missed a field goal, and the score remained Indiana 6, Michigan 0. The Hoosiers went on to win 13-6 in overtime.

stories.summary: A quiet feedback deadline could shape elite equipment rules, putting separate standards for pros and recreational golfers back in focus. But last week, a potentially consequential date slipped past most golfers without much attention. Wednesday, Oct. 21, was the deadline for equipment makers and other stakeholders to provide feedback to a USGA and R&A Notice and Comment letter on topics they are exploring to address distance at the elite level. stories.title: The mistakes that cost Lewis Hamilton a podium at F1’s US GP
stories.summary: Hamilton narrowly missed out on the podium in Austin, which he reckoned was down to what happened in free practice The Ferrari driver started from fifth on the grid and jumped Isack Hadjar for fourth at lights out, despite being the only driver on used (soft) tyres for the opening stint. But Hamilton lost 0.277s per lap to team-mate Charles Leclerc during that stint, as well as 0.422s to Max Verstappen , with the pair on new soft tyres. Those few seconds corresponded to the time the Briton was missing to beat Verstappen to third at the end of the Austin race – and perhaps surpass Leclerc for second.

stories.title: World Rally Championship is officially coming to Kentucky in 2027
stories.summary: The World Rally Championship, a major international motorsport series, is bringing a rally to Tennessee and Kentucky in 2027. Knoxville, Tennessee, will serve as host city for the rally, with the rally's headquarters, team bases and fan activations held at the World's Fair Park and the Knoxville Convention Center. A ceremonial start for the event will be held on Lower Broadway in Nashville, and hometown celebrations will take place alongside the stages in Eastern Tennessee and Eastern Kentucky. The U.S. rally will be the first time the WRC has raced in the country since 1988.
